purpose: Host-neutral capability and evidence contract. Presence of a config file or chat response is never sufficient for NATIVE status.

claude-code.rule: Verify actual host capabilities and any claimed lifecycle hook by a disposable receipt. Current provider HARD_OFF remains separate from host installation status.

codex-cli.rule: Verify actual host capabilities and any claimed lifecycle hook by a disposable receipt. Current provider HARD_OFF remains separate from host installation status.

hermes-agent.rule: Discover real lifecycle/tool/state capabilities; never invent hook names or native discovery semantics.

chatgpt-web.rule: Use connected capabilities actually present in the session. Repository connector access can be ADAPTED without implying local runtime hooks.

claude-web.rule: Read/analyze context if available; do not claim hooks/state/effects without observed execution receipts.

grok-web.rule: Read/analyze context if available; do not claim hooks/state/effects without observed execution receipts.

generic.rule: Inventory capabilities first and map only what exists.
